identity.title: Hermes Strategy Manager Core — V2.1 Soft Strategy Judgment
identity.objective: Implement a deterministic, auditable Hermes strategy-manager layer that evaluates one exact StrategyVersion against a verified STRAT-LIFE snapshot and bounded admissible evidence, invokes the existing controlled Hermes research runtime once under a default-off strategy-assessment output contract, validates the untrusted output, and persists a canonical soft strategy decision with exact predecessor/runtime/evidence/state lineage in an append-only caller-selected SQLite history store; no STRAT-LIFE mutation, no credential/order/paper/execution/live/policy authority, zero real provider calls.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Explicit Side15/Karl authorization (Scope Amendment 01) for exactly two additional historical Hermes compatibility-guard test paths mechanically required by the pre-existing tracked-file allowlists. The added paths only register the already-authorized S10-HERMES-STRAT-01 source/test artifacts. No capability, runtime, dependency, network, credential, scheduler, strategy, paper, execution, live, Control Center, DATA-03, or merge authority is broadened.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the exact S10-HERMES-STRAT-01 diff. The default-off strategy mode, strategy_manager.py, its tests, the contract, status fragment, package artifacts, docs reconciliation and the two exact historical guard path exceptions disappear; generic and context Hermes modes are unchanged; no existing store, schema or runtime state changes and no external runtime, provider, order or capital state exists to roll back.
